syl: ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᎵᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏛᎢ ᎤᎵᏬᏨ ᏗᎧᎾᏗ ᏥᏄᏍᏕᎢ,
pho: gó:sda:yi digá:hltisdóhdi gá:ye:sadv´:'i u:li:hwo:tsv di:gandi tsinu:sdei,

eng: but the Cherokees wanted to know for sure,
so they built a big fire
and threw the witch on it.

syl: ᏍᎩᏴᏃ ᎠᏥᎳ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏴᏫᏯ ᏣᎾᏛᎩᏍᎨ
pho: sgiyvhno atsí:la agó:hvsgv´ hí'a ani:yv:wiyá tsani:tv:gí:sge
eng: As the fire burned, the people heard
songs coming from the fire, songs of healing.

syl: ᏍᎩᏴ ᎤᏐᏅᎢ ᎠᏓᏪᎯ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᎵᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏍᏛᎢ ᎩᎳᎯᏯ ᏧᏂᏲᏍᏓᏁᎢ,
pho: sgiyv u:so:nv´'i adawé:hi go:sdáyi digá:tisdóhdi gá:yesadi kilá:hí:ya tsuni:yó:sdané:'i,
eng: When Spearfinger's evil magic was finally destroyed,

syl: ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ ᏃᎴ ᎤᎾᎾᏔ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏓ ᎯᎪᎢᎦ.
pho: hí'a ani:tsalagi unatvganv nole unanta sgina dikahno:gí:da hi:go í:ga.
eng: The Cherokees listened, and they remember those songs to this day.
